remarks: Never before on the market! A Rare Waterfront End- End-Unit in Charles Cove Experience unparalleled waterfront living in this exceptional end-unit 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home. Situated in the gated community of Charles Cove, this one-of-a-kind residence offers unobstructed views , a private dock accommodating boats up to 48.5 feet, and a beautifully landscaped side yard-a unique feature within the community. The first-floor primary suite boasts breathtaking water views, allowing you to wake up to the sight of your own boat and dock just outside your window. The en-suite bathroom includes a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and a private sauna. This level also features a laundry room and direct access to your private one-car garage. Designed for seamless entertaining, the second floor showcases an open-concept living and dining area with soaring cathedral ceilings, oversized windows, and a fireplace. The gourmet kitchen flows effortlessly into the space, while an expansive deck provides the perfect setting for al fresco dining and stunning views over the water. The third-floor retreat offers a private bedroom, full bath, and magnificent south- and east-facing water views, making it an ideal guest suite or peaceful escape. As a true end-unit, this home offers enhanced privacy and a rare side yard with mature trees-an exclusive feature in Charles Cove. Propane gas is available for this unit. ALL OFFERS MUST BE DELIVERED BY 5:00 TODAY FEB.24TH.
